## 📸 Face-Sort-Studio Pull Request Checklist

Thank you for contributing to Face-Sort-Studio! Please verify the following checklist before submitting:

- [ ] I have tested my changes locally with sample photos and verified the clustering / UI streaming.
- [ ] My code adheres to PEP-8 guidelines and standard Python packaging practices.
- [ ] I have updated `README.md` or version documentation if adding new dependencies or features.
- [ ] No personal photos or test datasets are included in this PR.
